We carefully select products that give us a warm and cozy feeling in our own homes. That's what we call "hygge" in our home country of Denmark, where most of the designers we work with are also from. Most of our products are handmade and we emphasize natural materials such as wood, because they possess a cozy animated feeling that sleek designs in metal just can't replicate. It is this emphasis on animated designs, natural materials, and the finish only hand-crafted products have that enable a true emotional connection between our customers and products.
